_meta._note: Strict primary-source ingestion from 2 NEW reference investigations: (1) Scale Labs Audio MultiChallenge leaderboard at labs.scale.com/leaderboard/audiomc — 30 leaderboard entries extracted, ingest the canonical highest-mode score per model. arxiv 2512.14865 paper. Audio MultiChallenge by Scale AI SEAL: 452 conversations / 47 speakers / 14.99 hr / 1,712 instance-specific rubrics / 5 axes (Inference Memory + Instruction Retention + Self Coherence + Voice Editing + Audio-Cue). Average Pass Rate (APR) metric. (2) HuggingFace Big Bench Audio release blog (https://huggingface.co/blog/big-bench-audio-release, Dec 20 2024) — 1,000 audio Qs across 4 BIG-Bench-Hard categories (Formal Fallacies/Navigate/Object Counting/Web of Lies). GPT-4o text-only = 92 ingested as primary baseline. Skipped duplicates: gpt-realtime-2 (48.45 audio xHigh already in DB as 48.5 from OpenAI primary) + gpt-realtime-1.5 (34.73 already in DB as 34.7). Snapshot IDs (gpt-realtime-2025-08-28) collapsed to canonical names. New audio model variants (qwen3-omni-instruct vs existing thinking variant) registered separately per their distinct evals.
